name: io.github.allooloo/getcounterparty
title: Allooloo Counterparty
description: Licence status of capital markets firms, read from the regulator's own register. Signed, receipted.

tools.name: get_counterparty
tools.description: Licence status of a capital markets counterparty. Returns the regulator's record of one firm: whether it is licensed, authorised or registered, by which regulator, for what, and since when the register says so. Give a Legal Entity Identifier, or a market and the regulator's firm number. Every field carries its source page and the date it was read. The record is signed; the read leaves a receipt.

market.description: The market, two letters (for example uk). On a market's own MCP it may be left out.

firm_number.description: The regulator's firm number, exactly as the register writes it.

version.description: A version of the record (default: the current version).

tools.name: resolve_counterparty
tools.description: The candidate firms for a name and, if given, a market: each with its identifiers, market, grouping and status. Never a guess at which one is meant; read the one you mean with get_counterparty.

name.description: A firm name, or part of one.

market.description: The market, two letters (for example uk). On a market's own MCP it may be left out.

tools.name: list_counterparties
tools.description: The firms of one market, by grouping (Bank, Broker-dealer, Investment firm, Fund manager, Venue, Other) or by status in the register's own words, paged.

market.description: The market, two letters (for example uk). On a market's own MCP it may be left out.

status.description: A status exactly as the register writes it (the answer's statuses list names them).

tools.name: verify_counterparty
tools.description: Whether a firm record's signature verifies against the published keys. Give the record exactly as get_counterparty served it. Nothing is read; anyone can do the same offline with the key in the answer.

record.description: A record exactly as get_counterparty served it.

tools.name: resolve_issuer
tools.description: Find a listed company by ticker, ISIN or LEI. The router names the issuer's home market and forwards to that market's MCP for the record summary.

identifier.description: Ticker with or without exchange (SHOP, TSX:SHOP, SHEL.L, BHP.AX, D05.SI, NESN.SW, SAP.DE, 7203.T, 005930.KS), ISIN, LEI, an exact legal name or a sourced alias.

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Return the full issuer record, served by the MCP of the issuer's home market. The router stores no records.

tools.name: get_orderability
tools.description: The AIO-10060 orderability outcome for one listed security and one client category of its home market's chapter: the router finds the issuer's home market by the subject, as for get_record, and that market's MCP produces it — one ACM-68000 signal where the evidence reaches it, or evidence_gaps with the pages checked and no signal; every element points at its chapter or record field; signed by the node (kid allooloo-eco-2026-10) and receipted at mcp.rco-records.ai with the node as writer.

subject.description: ISIN (best), ticker with exchange (TSX:SHOP, SHEL.L), LEI or CMR key.

client_category.description: One client category exactly as the market's chapter names it (the node door's /book/aio.json, client_categories).

tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: Every market on the roster (nodes.json, with its region), which are live, and each market's MCP and agent card.
